# CustomGrabPose

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/CustomGrabPose.cs#L14)

Marks a hand that is standing in for the player's while a pose is authored on a grip point.

Nothing here is read at run time. A pose is [`GripPose`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/GripPose) data on the
[`GripPoint`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/GripPoint), and the hand carrying this component exists only while somebody is
looking at it: it is spawned at the root of the scene when editing starts, read back when
editing stops, and destroyed. Being at the root is the point - parented under the object it
would take the object's scale, and a hand has one size.

```csharp
public class CustomGrabPose : MonoBehaviour
```
